name: observed-remote-platform-v1
purpose: An uncalibrated local estimator of the observable remote scoring interface; it does not claim recovery of the hidden server-side answer key.

upload.max_bytes_basis: The page displays 30 MB; this local preflight uses 30 * 1024 * 1024 bytes until the server-side comparison is calibrated.

local_safety_limits.purpose: Defend the local estimator from ZIP expansion attacks. These are local extraction limits, not an assertion about the remote server.

offline_matching_model.evidence: exact event-ID coverage with a conservative precision penalty for every unreviewed candidate event
offline_matching_model.stage: exact stage match for matched event IDs
offline_matching_model.timeline: one-to-one source-step match using equal stage, evidence F1, and endpoint/overlap time score; unmatched candidate rows reduce precision
offline_matching_model.nodes: exact id and type coverage; extra nodes do not reduce score
offline_matching_model.edges: one-to-one exact from/to/action/stage match, requiring corroborating cited evidence before time/evidence partial credit; unmatched candidate rows reduce precision
offline_matching_model.ioc: one-to-one canonical type/value match requiring either cited evidence or temporal corroboration, then scoring time, assets, and cited-evidence F1

known_limits: The hidden answer set, score thresholds, and tie-breaking behavior are not exposed by the platform.
The 90-second tolerance and partial-credit ratios are local assumptions retained from the prior transparent scorer until a controlled remote calibration is authorized.
Local ZIP uncompressed-size caps defend this estimator and are not evidence of matching remote extraction limits.
